mapper.insert: insert into t_flow_definition (id, app_code, flow_key, flow_name,flow_type, flow_content, remark,deleted,created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) values (#{id},#{appCode},#{flowKey},#{flowName},#{flowType},#{flowContent},#{remark},0,now(),#{createdBy},now(),#{updatedBy});
mapper.select: select id, app_code, flow_key as flowKey, flow_name as flowName,flow_type as flowType,flow_content as flowContent, remark,deleted from t_flow_definition where flow_key = #{flowKey} and app_Code=#{appCode} and deleted=0

select id, app_code, flow_key as flowKey, flow_name as flowName,flow_type as flowType, remark, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, flow_content as flowContent from t_flow_definition where 1=1 and deleted=0
and flow_name like concat("%",#{flowName},"%")
and flow_type = #{flowType}
and app_code = #{appCode} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

(#{item.id},#{item.appCode},#{item.flowKey},#{item.flowName},#{item.flowType},#{item.flowContent},#{item.remark},0,now(),#{item.createdBy},now(),#{item.updatedBy})
